title: Sunset with Laurence and Marietta 🫶

Our last night in Barcelona…. And the cruise was a great way to say goodbye to Barcelona.
Laurence and Marietta were fabulous.  The sunset was amazing too.  Highly recommend’

title: Relaxing!

title: exceptional Yacht and crew!

title: Loveeeeddddd everything!!!
text: Lawrence was amazing! He and Marieta were both super accommodating. I loved our ride and our pictures came out so beautifully. This was such a cute and relaxing start to our evening. We’re feeling amazing and super happy.

title: A Fantastic Sunset Cruise!
text: Great cruise.   Lawrence and Marieta were the best crew.  Home made sangria was fabulous and the views were fantastic.  Highly recommend.
author: Chris_H

title: My friends and I had the...
text: My friends and I had the most amazing time on this cruise! This was our first time on a sailboat and we very much enjoyed it. Catching the sunset was a plus and we got some great pictures and videos.

title: worth it
